subject: Conflict between Structural General Notes S-001 and Foundation Plan S-101 over the embed

messages.text: The embed plate location shown in Structural General Notes S-001 at Gridline C/4 conflicts with the mechanical ductwork and architectural ceiling framing routing shown in Foundation Plan S-101. This is critical -- we need immediate direction to keep fabrication moving. There could be a cost impact if rework of embedded items is required. This could affect the erection sequence schedule. Please respond before the fabricator's shop drawing cutoff.

Revise the embed plate per Foundation Plan S-101; coordinate final dimensions with the affected trades before fabrication. There could be a cost impact if rework of embedded items is required. This could affect the erection sequence schedule.

To confirm, should the embed plate at Gridline C/4 remain per Structural General Notes S-001, or do we wait for a revised Foundation Plan S-101? Please respond before the fabricator's shop drawing cutoff.
